timing: Post-screening assessment. The analysis amendment was frozen after operational metrics and before condition-level results; the level-specific bias amendment was frozen after recognizing constraint cancellation and before producing level-specific results.

facets_python_parity.precision_note: FACETS displayed measures/thresholds are compared under the registered Umean=6 primary path; displayed fit values are not treated as hidden raw precision.

global_shape_rmse.main: 0/90 non-normal-minus-normal RMSE intervals excluded zero; maximum absolute mean contrast was 0.00882 logits.
global_shape_rmse.threshold: 0/30 threshold-RMSE intervals excluded zero; maximum absolute mean contrast was 0.02448 logits.
global_shape_rmse.interpretation: At matched realized mean and SD, population shape did not show a stable global recovery-RMSE effect at 20 replicates. This is absence of a screening signal, not proof of invariance.

planned_missingness_rmse.task: 20/20 intervals excluded zero; range 0.01226 to 0.02599 logits.
planned_missingness_rmse.criterion: 14/20 intervals excluded zero; range 0.00618 to 0.01951 logits.
planned_missingness_rmse.thresholds: 20/20 intervals excluded zero; range 0.01865 to 0.08472 logits.
planned_missingness_rmse.interpretation: Observation design was the dominant global recovery axis across joint, marginal, and conditional estimands.

free_sd_mml.mixture_minus_normal: Intervals included zero in both designs.
free_sd_mml.planned_minus_complete: Only the normal contrast excluded zero: +0.029316 (screening interval +0.00247 to +0.05616).
free_sd_mml.interpretation: Free population dispersion is sensitive to shape even when every realized generator SD equals 0.8. The one-seed preflight suggestion of uniformly lower SD under missingness did not replicate, demonstrating why the repeated study was necessary.

local_bias.main_shape: 12/270 unadjusted element-level shape intervals excluded zero: fixed-SD MML 9, free-SD MML 3, FACETS/Python JMLE and exact CMLE 0. Right-skew planned data shifted the two Criterion levels by approximately +/-0.0141 in fixed-SD MML and +/-0.0109 in free-SD MML.
local_bias.threshold_shape_consensus: For symmetric-mixture data, all five estimator modes showed C02 category-2 error contrasts around -0.075 to -0.080 in complete data; in planned-connected data all five showed C02 category-1 contrasts +0.082 to +0.100 and category-2 contrasts -0.115 to -0.124.
local_bias.interpretation: Global RMSE can remain stable while bias redistributes among constrained levels/steps. Level-specific ledgers are therefore required; facet-average signed error is not a valid bias screen under sum-to-zero alignment.

cmle_information.interpretation: Every CMLE fit remained eligible, but shape and missingness altered the small amount of Person information lost to extreme totals. Conditional estimation removes Person parameters; it does not make the observed total-score information invariant.

withheld: No estimator ranking, confirmatory significance, coverage, power, false-positive, universal distribution invariance, or automatic estimator recommendation. The many element-level screening intervals are unadjusted and used only to select independent future contrasts.
decision: The 20-replicate screen is complete. A future confirmatory study should use 100 fresh replicates not reused from the screening, prospectively target free-SD shape contrasts, symmetric-mixture C02 local threshold contrasts, planned-missingness recovery loss, and extreme-Person rates, and set Monte Carlo precision before generation.
